claims.claim: Very sound and working fine borehole drilling machine
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a truck-mounted crane/boom (orange crane/boom and hydraulic components). No clear borehole drilling rig components (mast/drill head/rotary table/rig frame) are shown.

claims.claim: Buy to site condition for very serious bayas
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of site-ready status; witness did not report operational testing.
Photos show equipment but do not confirm it starts, runs, or that hydraulics/crane functions work.
No service records, invoices, or inspection stickers are shown/readable.
Witness notes hydraulic components and crane/boom, but completeness of drilling-specific parts is not shown.
Brand/model/serial identifiers are not readable in the witness report.

risks.risk: Item may not be a borehole drilling machine; photos indicate a truck-mounted crane/boom truck, so drilling capability/rig components may be missing.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the drilling rig assembly (mast/rig frame, drill head/rotary system, Kelly bar/rods interface, rotary table or top drive, mud pump/hoses if applicable) mounted on the truck.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a truck-mounted crane/boom truck only (not a complete borehole drilling rig), worst-case for missing drilling components.

risks.risk: Hydraulic crane/boom may not lift/extend/hold pressure correctly (leaks, weak pump, worn cylinders/hoses).
risks.proof: Short video clip of the crane/boom performing: lift to a set height, extend/retract, and hold position without dropping; include a close-up of hose/cylinder area for leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as hydraulics unproven (assume possible leaks/weak performance) and treat as needing inspection/repair.

risks.risk: Truck engine/transmission/brakes/steering may be faulty even if the crane looks intact.
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start (or start), idle, gear engagement/drive test, and a brake/steering check (straight line + gentle stop).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed running/roadworthy; worst-case for drivetrain/brake issues.

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn/cracked and could require replacement soon; spare availability unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tyres (tread depth/sidewall cracks) plus a photo showing spare tyre and jack/tools.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres are worn and may need replacement.

risks.risk: Electrical/safety features may be incomplete or non-functional (lights, indicators, horn, crane safety locks).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing all exterior lights working (headlights, indicators, brake lights, reverse lights) and crane control/safety interlocks engaged.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming electrical/safety items may need repair.

risks.risk: Hidden structural damage (frame/chassis straightness, mounting points) could affect safe operation.
risks.proof: Underbody/frame inspection photos: mounting brackets for crane, crossmembers, and any visible cracks/bends; include a straight-edge/level check if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential structural risk (worst-case) until inspected.

risks.risk: Model/year/mileage unknown; value depends heavily on make/model and condition.
risks.proof: Clear photos of VIN/chassis plate, engine number, odometer reading, and any registration/inspection documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for unknown model/year/mileage (use lowest plausible category).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact item: is it a complete borehole drilling rig or only a truck-mounted crane/boom? Send photos of the drilling rig components (mast/rotary/top drive/drill head) if present.
Send a short video showing the truck starting, driving a short distance, and braking/steering checks.
Send a short video of crane/boom operation: lift, extend/retract, and hold pressure without dropping; show any hose/cylinder areas for leaks.
Send close-up photos of all tyres (tread + sidewall) and a photo of the spare tyre and tools.
Send photos/videos of all exterior lights and indicators working, plus crane control/safety features.
Send photos of VIN/chassis plate, engine number, odometer, and any service/maintenance records or dealer invoice.
response.reason: The witness photos support a truck-mounted crane/boom, but they do not verify borehole drilling rig components or confirm working condition via operation tests. Without those proof shots/videos, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
